blocks.orig: The Mawe Mawe Manyara Lodge is a boutique lodge on the edge of the Rift Valley overlooking Lake Manyara National Park. It serves as a gateway to Ngorongoro Crater, Serengeti and Tarangire. The lodge features a main house and villas (some with plunge pools and outdoor showers) that blend modern comfort with local materials, offering privacy, spacious interiors, and breathtaking views across the valley. The main building has an infinity pool, a large entertainment area, a spa, a restaurant, and a bar – great for winding down after a safari day. And when you sit by the fire after a meal of freshly prepared food and fine wines and admire the African sky, you know you found a special place in the middle of the wilderness.
blocks.html: Overlooking Lake Manyara National Park from the rim of the Rift Valley, the Mawe Mawe Manyara Lodge is a boutique lodge and a handy base for Ngorongoro Crater, Serengeti and Tarangire. Guests stay in the main house or in villas, some of which have a plunge pool and an outdoor shower; local materials are combined with modern comforts, and you get plenty of privacy, roomy interiors and a breathtaking view across the valley. The main building is home to a spa, a bar, a restaurant, a big entertainment area and an infinity pool – perfect for relaxing after a day of game viewing. When you then sit at the fire after fresh food and good wine, looking up at the African sky, you will feel you have discovered somewhere special in the heart of the wilderness.
